title: Graph mode ops.repeat_interleave fails with scalar Tensor repeats
duplicate_search_queries: site:github.com/mindspore-ai/mindspore/issues repeat_interleave Tensor repeats "Convert data failed" MindSpore
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found. Broad version-merge issues mention repeat_interleave but do not match this scalar Tensor repeats Graph failure.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 ops.repeat_interleave documents repeats as Union[int, tuple, list, Tensor] and lists CPU as a supported platform.
The same documentation examples show scalar Python-int repeats on axis 0 and axis 1.
A 1-D Tensor containing a single repeat count and a vector Tensor repeats input both compile in Graph mode, so this is localized to 0-D/scalar Tensor repeats.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: all checks are exact int32 repeat results or metadata, and Graph mode fails before producing a result.
Not a CPU unsupported issue: PyNative succeeds on CPU, Python-int repeats succeed in Graph mode, and Tensor-vector repeats succeed in Graph mode.
Not a reference-expression artifact: TRI-001 and TRI-002 reproduce the Graph failure independently for axis 0 and axis 1.
The Graph error is a framework unexpected exception: 'Convert data failed' at static_analysis/prim.cc:729 RunPyInferValue.
